title: Guarded prepared nasal spray logging, exact-bottle debit and Undo, and approved iPhone UX

changes.title: Log a verified prepared nasal spray dose
changes.detail: Review exact prepared bottle and whole spray count, then save a linked administration, prepared stock debit and immutable ledger under a shared Web Lock with optimistic stale-state protection and readback-confirmed storage.

changes.title: Restore the exact prepared bottle on Undo
changes.detail: Undo reverses the original spray transaction, restores only the prepared bottle balance and removes its exact history dose without recrediting or re-debiting original physical vials. Stale/edited/repeated reversals fail closed.

changes.title: Protect existing saved records in concurrent tabs
changes.detail: Canonical durable comparison ignores temporary rendering fields but blocks unsaved persistent changes, stale tabs, invalid sources, insufficient balances and unverified writes.

changes.title: Preserve previously accepted search and calculator experiences
changes.detail: Keep the single aligned 44px search-clear button, syringe-size recovery, and independent read-only theoretical nasal calculator without redesigning approved DS2 screens.

dataImpact: No destructive migration, reset, import, background sync, or rewrite of existing production storage key peptide-tracker-html-v1. On user-confirmed successful prepared nasal administration only, add one dated dose/history record and one exact prepared-bottle ledger event with balance deduction in one exclusive verified write. Undo reverses that one event without changing physical vial balance. Failed, stale, invalid or insufficient source operations must not acknowledge success; full-app DEMO uses isolated fictional state.
limitations: This is an UNMERGED and UNDEPLOYED v0.9.26-beta release candidate; user GO authorized development and validation, not publication. Real LIVE on production main remains disabled until separately approved release.
Only verified prepared nasal bottles with calibrated per-actuation fields are eligible. No added medical dosing recommendation or independent pump stability/clinical safety certification.
Generic preparation transfer controls remain OFF. Recorded nasal preparation flow remains independently controlled and unchanged.
Physical iPhone Safari and VoiceOver acceptance of this enabled-source candidate are pending. Automated Chromium/WebKit does not constitute physical iPhone testing.
No assumption that a successful GitHub PR merge alone establishes primary Cloudflare source parity.
